description: A bearded man in a white turban and a torn red-and-gold robe walks forward on a dusty battlefield, flanked by armoured soldiers in mail and helmets. On the right, an elderly bearded man in a white turban sits on a cushioned seat inside a large ornate tent, holding a staff. Behind them stand a grey war elephant with a howdah, a mounted rider on a dark horse, smoke and debris scattered on the ground. No visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
